blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Image-to-code methods for 3D scene reconstruction produce executable code that generates editable digital content and supports visual simulation. However, existing methods primarily rely on appearance similarity, which provides limited guidance for distinguishing errors in geometry, materials, and illumination. Light shapes scene appearance through its interactions with geometry and materials, influencing shading, cast shadows, and reflections. We therefore present LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning into iterative scene reconstruction. To be specific, we leverage complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination cues to jointly refine scene structure and appearance, and propose Lighting Reasoning Memory to maintain light-source hypotheses, which supports evidence, and revision history throughout iterations. Together, they support reasoning about partially visible and unseen sources, with evidence-guided verification directing subsequent revisions. Our framework reconstructs explicit scenes through coherent reasoning about geometry, materials, and illumination without additional training or differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior image-to-code reconstruction accuracy under challenging shadows and complex illumination, further supporting downstream scene editing, object insertion, and versatile relighting.
blocks.zh: 3D场景重建的图像到代码方法产生可执行代码,生成可编辑的数字内容并支持视觉模拟. 然而,现有方法主要依赖于外观相似性,这为区分几何,材料,和照明方面的错误提供了有限的指导. 光的形状通过它与几何学和材料的相互作用来呈现场景,影响阴影,投影,反射. 因此,我们介绍LightHarness,这是一个基于VLM的代理框架,将明确的照明推理纳入迭代场景重建. 具体来说,我们利用互补的几何、内在和照明提示,共同完善场景结构和外观,并提出照明理性记忆,以维持支持证据的光源假设,并在整个迭代中修正历史。 它们共同支持关于部分可见和看不见的来源的推理,证据指导核查指导随后的修订。 我们的框架通过对几何学、材料和光线的连贯推理来重建清晰的场景,而不增加训练或不同的渲染。 广泛的实验显示,在具有挑战性的阴影和复杂的照明下,图像到代码重建的精度更高,进一步支持下游场景编辑、物体插入和多功能的照明。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reconstructing an executable, editable 3D scene from a single image connects visual understanding with digital scene creation.
Image-to-code reconstruction offers a promising direction: a scene program ( e.g. , Blender, Three.js) explicitly represents geometry, spatial layout, materials, cameras, and light sources, enabling novel-view rendering and subsequent scene editing [ 35 , 10 , 29 ] .
Except for spatial grounding that concerns object poses or location, lighting is also central to this process.
Shading, cast shadows, highlights and reflections arise from the complex interactions between illumination, geometry, and materials.
Accurate image-to-code reconstruction requires recovering object structure and layout together with the illumination that explains their observed appearance.
blocks.zh:
从一个单一图像中重建一个可执行,可编辑的3D场景,将视觉理解与数字场景创建相连接.
图像到代码的重建提供了一个有希望的方向:一个场景程序(例如:Blender,Tree.js)明确代表几何,空间布局,材料,相机,和光源,使得能进行小说取景和随后的场景编辑[35,10,29].
除了涉及物体所处位置的空间地平面外,照明也是这一过程的核心。
阴影、阴影、突出和反射产生于照明、几何和材料之间的复杂相互作用。
精确的图像到代码重建需要恢复对象结构和布局,同时进行能解释其被观察到外观的照明.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Conceptual comparison of image-to-code paradigms. (a) Appearance feedback emphasizes rendered–reference similarity. (b) Tool-grounded refinement uses perception and spatial analysis to improve layout. (c) LightHarness combines enriched evidence and persistent memory for explicit lighting reasoning throughout reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 图2:图像与代码范式的概念比较。 (a) 外观反馈强调提供的参考相似性。 (b) 以工具为基础的改进利用感知和空间分析改进布局。 (c) LightHarness将丰富的证据和持续的记忆结合起来,在整个重建过程中进行明确的照明推理。

blocks.en:
Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) [ 24 , 9 ] have enabled scene construction through executable programs, connecting visual and semantic reasoning with explicit control over scene components.
This capability supports a common iterative paradigm: an agent proposes or edits a scene program, inspects the rendered result, and revises its proposal based on visual feedback.
SceneCraft [ 11 ] and BlenderAlchemy [ 12 ] demonstrate this paradigm to be effective in text-driven construction and appearance-guided editing, respectively.
Extending it to reconstruction from visual input enjoys richer editing applications, and requires the VLMs to determine which scene configuration could explain the observed image.
Recent systems formulate this problem through plan and observation management [ 35 ] , staged refinement of scene attributes [ 10 ] , or explicit geometric, material, and light modeling [ 26 , 4 ] in synthetic game scenes.
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型(VLMs)[24,9]的近期进步使得场景构建能够通过可执行程序,将视觉和语义推理与对场景组件的明确控制相连接.
此能力支持一个常见的迭代范式:一个代理提出或编辑一个场景程序,检查得到的结果,并根据视觉反馈修改其建议.
SceneCraft [11]和BlenderAlchemy [12] 分别证明了这种范式在文本驱动的构造和外观引导的编辑上是有效的.
从视觉输入扩展到重建,可以享有更丰富的编辑应用程序,需要VLMs来确定哪个场景配置可以解释被观测到的图像.
近期的系统通过计划和观测管理[35],分阶段地完善场景属性[10],或者在合成游戏场景中明确几何,材料,和光线模型[26,4]来表达这个问题.

blocks.en:
Across these approaches, rendered-reference comparisons provide a central feedback signal for scene revision.
However, such a discrepancy on appearance does not uniquely identify its underlying cause, because similar image differences can arise from geometry, reflectance, or illumination.
For example, a dark region may arise from low surface reflectance, a surface facing away from light sources, or insufficient illumination from an unseen source.
Simply brightening the material can reduce a local image discrepancy, but leave the underlying illumination error unresolved, leading to an incorrect material estimation.
The challenge is therefore to connect observed lighting effects to their plausible geometric, material, and illumination explanations.
This motivates our central question: How can we explicitly reason about scene geometry, materials, and light sources for more accurate image-to-code reconstruction beyond appearance?
blocks.zh:
在整个这些办法中,提供参考的比较为场景修改提供了中央反馈信号。
然而,这种外观上的差异并不独有地识别出其根本原因,因为相类似的图像差异可能由几何,反射或发光而来.
例如,从低地表反射、从光源外向的地表或从看不见的地出光源的光照不足,可能会产生出一个暗的区域。
简单亮出材料可以减少局部的图像相差,但留下了潜在的发光出错未解决,导致材料估计不正确.
因此,面临的挑战是将所观察到的照明效果与其可能的几何、材料和照明解释联系起来。
这引发了我们的中心问题: 我们如何能明确解释场景几何、材料和光源,以便进行比外观更准确的图像到代码重建?

blocks.en:
To mitigate this, we propose LightHarness , a VLM-based agent framework that incorporates explicit lighting modeling into iterative scene generation and verification with complementary evidence and reasoning .
We first associate light-source hypotheses with evidence of their interactions with scene geometry and materials.
Specifically, we combine estimated HDR illumination [ 3 ] , depth and surface orientation [ 27 , 13 ] , intrinsic albedo and shading [ 13 ] .
These complementary sources of evidence relate appearance discrepancies to candidate revisions of the underlying scene factors, helping the generator agent determine which geometry, material, or light parameters to update during reconstruction, and finally output an executable Blender program.
As for the verifier agent , we equip it with a rubric scorer and a VLM. The rubric scorer assesses rendered-reference agreement based on predefined criteria, while the VLM uses these assessments, reference-image history revisions, and decomposed rendering evidence to diagnose and propose refinement updates.
blocks.zh:
为了缓解这种情况,我们提议使用基于VLM的代理框架LightHarness,将明确的照明模型纳入到迭代场景的生成和核查中,同时补充证据和推理。
我们首先将光源假设与它们与场景几何和材料相互作用的证据联系起来.
具体地说,我们综合了估计的《人类发展报告》照明[3]、深度和地表取向[27、13]、内在反照率和阴影[13]。
这些补充证据来源涉及外观差异与潜在场景因子的候选修改,帮助生成者代理确定在重建过程中需要更新的几何,材料,或光参数,最后输出可执行的Blender程序.
至于核查员 我们给它配备了记分器和VLM 标点计分器根据预先确定的标准评估提供参考协议,而VLM则使用这些评估,参考图像历史修订,并分解出证据来诊断并提出完善更新.

blocks.en:
To preserve and refine illumination reasoning iteratively in the proposed agentic system, we design Lighting Reasoning Memory (LRM), shared by the generator and verifier agents.
LRM associates each hypothesized light source with a group of stable parameters, including identity, visibility, location, color, etc. , establishing a clear correspondence among observations, editable Blender elements and the revision history. Notably , we explicitly consider partially visible, occluded, and off-frame light sources as hypotheses, enabling a more complete model of scene illumination that accounts for both visible and inferred light sources.
In each iteration, the generator uses this persistent lighting proxy to build scene programs and refine parameters, while the verifier examines it based on rendered evidence and recommends corrections.
By incorporating source-specific observations, decisions, and their supporting evidence in a synergistic framework, LRM provides persistent illumination-centric context for LightHarness , enabling subsequent geometry, material, and lighting revisions to build coherently on historical judgments.
blocks.zh:
为了在拟议的代理系统中反复地保存和完善照明推理,我们设计了由生成者和核查者共享的照明理性记忆。
LRM将每个假想的光源与一组稳定的参数联系起来,包括身份,能见度,位置,颜色等,在观测,可编辑的Blender元素和修订历史之间建立了清晰的对应关系. 特别是,我们明确认为部分可见、被占有和框架外的光源是假设的,因此能够有一个更完整的场景照明模型,既能说明可见和推断出光源。
在每个迭代中,生成器使用这种持续照明代用来构建场景程序并完善参数,而验证者则根据提供的证据对其进行审查,并建议进行更正.
通过将特定源的观测、决定及其佐证证据纳入一个协同框架,LRM为光Harness 提供了持续以发光为中心的背景,使随后的几何学、材料和照明修订能够以历史判断为连贯的基础。

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments demonstrate our competitive 3D image-to-code reconstruction accuracy.
We further verify our effectiveness on hard cases under complex lights and shadows, and showcase that our method can generalize to rich downstream applications, including image relighting, material/texture editing, and harmonious object insertion.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We propose a VLM-based 3D image-to-code reconstruction framework that incorporates explicit lighting modeling to guide the recovery of geometry, materials, and light sources in an executable scene program. • We introduce Lighting Reasoning Memory to preserve source identities, supporting evidence, and revision history across generation and verification, combining geometric and intrinsic priors with light-transport evidence to guide iterative scene refinement. • We demonstrate competitive 3D image-to-code reconstruction accuracy and further illustrate the utility of the reconstructed scenes through downstream applications, including image relighting, enhancement and complex light understanding.
blocks.zh:
广泛的实验证明了我们具有竞争力的 三维图像对代码重建精度.
我们进一步验证我们在复杂光线和阴影下对硬性病例的有效性,并展示我们的方法可以被概括到丰富的下游应用,包括图像再照、材料/文字编辑以及和谐对象插入。
• 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们提出了一个基于VLM的3D图像到代码重建框架,其中包含明确的照明模型,以指导几何、材料和光源在可执行的场景程序中的恢复。 我们引入了"照明理性记忆"来保存源身份,支持证据,并修改历代和验证,将几何和内在前传与光能运输证据相结合,以指导迭代场景的完善. ^ 我们展示了具有竞争力的三维图像到代码重建精度,并进一步说明了重建场景通过下游应用的效用,包括图像再光,增强和复杂的光能理解.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Lighting Estimation. Inverse rendering [ 14 ] aims to estimate scene geometry, reflectance, and illumination to explain observed image appearance and enable editing [ 15 ] .
PhotoScene [ 33 ] optimizes materials and lighting on approximately aligned CAD geometry, while Materialist [ 28 ] combines intrinsic prediction with differentiable material and environment-light refinement.
Multi-view methods further constrain material and illumination recovery through shared observations [ 32 , 18 ] .
LUMEN [ 3 ] instead predicts local HDR illumination, providing a lighting prior rather than a complete scene program.
Generative relighting also incorporates physical guidance and local control through light-transport consistency [ 36 ] , intrinsic conditioning and scribbles [ 6 ] , or estimated illumination priors [ 34 ] .
These methods provide complementary forms of lighting estimation and control, with different assumptions about available geometry and observations.
Our focus is to use such evidence to guide geometry, material, and light revisions during executable scene reconstruction, with relighting as a downstream application.
blocks.zh:
点燃估计. 反向渲染 [14] 旨在估计场景几何,反射和发光,以解释所观察到的图像外观并允许编辑 [15].
PhotoScene [33] 在大约对齐的CAD几何上优化了材料和照明,而Matericist [28] 结合了内在的预测与可分辨的材料和环境光的完善.
多视图方法通过共同观测进一步制约了材料和照明回收[32,18].
LUMEN [3]转而预测当地的HDR照明,提供先发光而不是完整的场景程序.
转光再照还包含通过光运输一致性[36]、内在条件和拼写[6]或估计的照明前传[34]进行物理指导和局部控制。
这些方法提供了照明估计和控制的补充形式,对现有几何学和观测有不同的假设.
我们的重点是在可执行场景重建期间利用这种证据指导几何学、材料和光线修改,再照为下游应用。

blocks.en:
Executable Scene Representations and Agentic Reconstruction. SceneCraft [ 11 ] translates scene descriptions and spatial constraints into Blender programs, while BlenderAlchemy [ 12 ] searches scene edits through rendered feedback.
For image-to-code reconstruction, VIGA [ 35 ] combines generation and verification with multimodal memory, and SEIG [ 10 ] refines geometry, materials, composition, and lighting in stages.
HARMONY [ 26 ] and Lumera [ 4 ] incorporate geometric priors and explicit illumination, with Lumera retaining shared refinement history.
VETR [ 21 ] additionally uses execution observations to distinguish proposed edits from their realized effects.
Notably, Code Video Model [ 17 ] combines executable codes with frontier generative models, achieving versatile controllable video generation.
Although these systems already incorporate multiple forms of scene evidence and iterative feedback, our focus is to maintain source-specific lighting hypotheses and connect memorable evolution to geometric, intrinsic, and decomposed rendering evidence throughout reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
可执行的场景代表性和代理重建. SceneCraft [11] 将场景描述和空间限制翻译为 Blender 程序,而 BlenderAlchemy [12] 搜索场景通过提供的反馈进行编辑.
对于图像到代码重建,VIGA [35]结合了生成和验证与多模式内存,而SEIG [10]则分阶段地精炼几何,材料,组成和照明.
HARMONY [26]和Lumera [4] 包含了几何前身和明显的发光,Lumera保留了共同的完善历史.
VETR [21] 额外使用执行观察来区分所拟议的编辑及其已实现的效果.
值得注意的是,代码视频模型[17]结合了可执行代码与前沿基因模型,实现了多功能可控视频生成.
虽然这些系统已经包括了多种形式的场景证据和迭代反馈,但我们的重点是维持特定源的照明假说,并将可记起的进化与几何,内在,并在整个重建过程中分解出证据联系起来.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : Overall pipeline of LightHarness. Geometric and lighting evidence guides a closed loop of perception, VLM-based generation, execution and rendering, and verification.
Rubric scoring and VLM diagnosis guide joint scene refinement, while Lighting Reasoning Memory preserves source states and diagnostic history across iterations.
blocks.zh:
图3:轻轨管道总结构。 几何和照明证据为闭环的感知、以VLM为基础的生成、执行和渲染以及核查提供指导。
Rubric评分和VLM诊断指导了联合场景的完善,而Lighting Reasoning Memory则保留了源态和诊断历史贯穿整个迭代.

blocks.en: 3.1 Motivation and Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 动机和概述

blocks.en:
Image-to-code reconstruction represents geometry, materials, and lighting in an executable program, providing an interpretable proxy for rendering, scene manipulation, and downstream applications.
Existing methods primarily exploit this problem through scene composition, spatial constraints, and interactive environments [ 11 , 19 , 8 ] .
However, faithful reconstruction requires understanding how scene components interact with light to produce the observed appearance.
Inferring lighting from incomplete observations is ill-posed because different scene configurations can produce similar images.
A dark wall may indicate low reflectance, occlusion, or a surface facing away from illumination.
Misinterpreting these effects can lead to incorrect materials or geometry, hampering reconstruction fidelity and subsequent editing.
We therefore treat lighting reasoning as a crucial part of image-to-code reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
图像到代码重建在可执行程序中代表几何,材料和照明,为渲染,场景操纵,下游应用提供可解释的代用.
现有方法主要通过场景组成、空间限制和互动环境利用这一问题[11、19、8]。
然而,忠实的重建需要了解场景组件如何与光相互作用以产生所观察到的外观.
从不完全的观测中推断出光线是不适当的,因为不同的场景配置可以产生相类似的图像.
暗墙可能表明反射率低,被遮住,或表面面临被照明.
错误地解释这些效果可能导致材料或几何不正确,会妨碍重建的忠实性并会后进行编辑.
因此,我们把照明推理视为图像到代码重建的关键部分。

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 3 , LightHarness formulates a T T -round loop which follows Perceive → \rightarrow Generator → \rightarrow Execute & Render → \rightarrow Verifier and combines visual evidence E E extracted from image I I with Lighting Reasoning Memory (LRM) M t M_{t} .
Perception forms the scene context, which guides the Generator in producing code C t C_{t} and light-source hypotheses.
Following rendering, rubric scoring and VLM diagnosis assess the reconstruction and guide subsequent revisions.
Generated scene states and verification findings update LRM, preserving evidence and reasoning across rounds.
The best valid candidate is selected by its rubric score, yielding jointly refined geometry, materials, and lighting for a wide range of downstream applications.
blocks.zh:
如图3所示,LightHarness在Perceive →\右手发电机 →\右手执行和Render →\右手验证器后形成一个 T T-圆环,并将从图像一中提取的可视证据E E 与Lighting Reasoning Memory (LRM) Mt M_{t}合并.
感知会会形成场景上下文,引导生成器生成代码C t C_{t}和光源假说.
在渲染后,Rumic分数和VLM诊断对重建进行评估并指导随后的修订.
生成场景状态和验证结果更新了LRM,保存了证据并进行了多轮推理.
最佳有效候选人按其分数选定,产生联合精炼的几何,材料,以及用于下游广泛应用的照明.

blocks.en: 3.2 Enriched Evidence for Lighting Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.2 照明理由的丰富证据

blocks.en:
Lighting reasoning requires both the spatial structure governing light transport and evidence of its effects on surfaces.
We extract complementary geometric, intrinsic, and lighting cues to support these judgments.
blocks.zh:
发光推理既需要规范发光运输的空间结构,也需要证明光运输对地表的影响。
我们提取了辅助几何、内在和照明提示来支持这些判断。

blocks.en:
Geometric evidence. SAM 3 [ 2 ] provides fine-grained semantic object masks, while
VGGT [ 27 ] estimates relative depth and cameras to establish a common reconstruction coordinate system.
For planar structures, we back-project reliable masked depth pixels and fit planes through robust estimation using least-squares refinement.
Each plane provides a surface point and normal for reasoning about position, orientation, and illumination.
Non-planar objects retain masks and depth cues without planar fitting.
blocks.zh:
几何证相. SAM 3[2]提供精细的语义物体口罩,而
VGGT [27] 估计相对深度和相机以建立共同的重建坐标系统.
对于平面结构,我们通过使用最小平面精度的强力估计,后期预测可靠的遮住深度像素和相机.

Evidence is extracted once and remains fixed, while its interpretation and reasoning evolve with rendering feedback.

blocks.en: 3.3 Lighting Reasoning Memory
blocks.zh: 3.3 照明原因记忆

blocks.en:
Scene revisions can change a light source’s contribution even when its parameters remain unchanged.
Lighting reasoning must therefore retain both current source states and the evidence underlying previous decisions.
Therefore, we propose shared Lighting Reasoning Memory (LRM): M t = ( S t , H t ) , M_{t}=(S_{t},H_{t}), (1) where S t S_{t} contains light-source states and H t H_{t} records diagnostic history.
We connect the stable light-source identities with corresponding Blender elements, where each state describes light visibility, type, position, orientation, intensity and color.
VLM visual reasoning [ 24 , 9 ] , guided by enriched evidence, also supports hypotheses of partially visible, occluded, and off-frame light sources.

blocks.en: 3.4 Evidence-Guided Verification
blocks.zh: 3.4 证据指导核查

blocks.en:
The Verifier consists a deterministic rubric scorer and a VLM diagnosis to assess reconstruction quality and guide scene refinement.
The scorer measures agreement with the reference image and enriched evidence, while the VLM interprets these measurements alongside rendered outputs and LRM to identify plausible causes of discrepancies.
blocks.zh:
核查器包括一个确定性标分器和一个VLM诊断,以评估重建质量并指导场景的改进.
计分员衡量与参考图像和丰富证据的一致程度,而VLM则对这些测量进行解释,同时提供产出和LRM,以确定出现差异的合理原因。

blocks.en:
Rubric-based assessment. The rubric is six-fold as below.
(1) Object-mask error measures projected-region disagreement.
(2) Relative-depth error compares reliable overlapping regions after positive scale alignment and penalizes missing coverage.
(3) Orientation error compares depth-derived plane normals while accounting for sign ambiguity.
(4-5) Albedo and diffuse-shading errors are measured in trusted diffuse regions in linear color space.
Shading uses one positive alignment scale shared across channels to preserve chromatic differences.
(6) RGB error evaluates overall appearance.
We aggregate these errors into scores q t q_{t} : q t = ∑ k ∈ 𝒦 w k ​ e t , k ∑ k ∈ 𝒦 w k , q_{t}=\frac{\sum_{k\in\mathcal{K}}w_{k}e_{t,k}}{\sum_{k\in\mathcal{K}}w_{k}}, (2) where 𝒦 \mathcal{K} indexes mask, depth, orientation, albedo, shading, and RGB errors.
Corresponding weights w k w_{k} remain fixed across rounds at ( 2 , 1 , 0.5 , 0.5 , 1 , 1 ) (2,1,0.5,0.5,1,1) , with sensitivity examined through ablations provided in the Supp.
Lower scores indicate better agreement and guide candidate selection without gradient-based optimization.

blocks.en:
Evidence-guided diagnosis. Beyond scalar assessment, the VLM combines component errors, rendered passes, source contributions, and LRM to recommend geometric, material, or lighting revisions.
For an underlit wall, it examines orientation, occlusion, albedo, and relevant source contributions.
Geometric discrepancies motivate structural revisions, whereas consistent geometry and albedo direct attention to lighting.
Each recommendation specifies the discrepancy, proposed revision, and supporting evidence, providing guidance for the subsequent reconstruction round.

对于一堵倒墙,它审查取向、隔离、反照率和有关来源的贡献。
几何差异促使结构修改,而相容的几何和反照率则直接关注照明.
每项建议都具体说明差异、拟议修订和佐证,为随后的重建回合提供指导。

Conditioned on this context and preceding scene code, the Generator jointly reasons about structure and illumination to produce t t -step code C t C_{t} and a light source state update Δ ​ S t \Delta S_{t} .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Our experiments compare reconstruction quality with recently blooming image-to-code methods, examine the roles of visual evidence and Lighting Reasoning Memory, and assess generalizable downstream application and hard cases.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验将重建质量与最近开花的图像到代码方法进行比较,审查视觉证据和光照理性记忆的作用,并评估下游可通用的应用和硬壳。

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We load external modules ( i.e. , SAM3, VGGT, Marigold, LUMEN) on two NVIDIA 4090-48G GPUs, and use GPT-6-Astra [ 24 ] as the Generator/Verifier VLM via API. All reconstructions are done with 10 rounds.
We also examine our framework under different VLMs in the Supplementary materials.
blocks.zh:
我们在两个NVIDIA 4090-48G GPU上加载外部模块(即SAM3,VGGT,Marigold,LUMEN),并通过API使用GPT-6-Astra [24]作为生成器/验证器VLM. 所有重建均以10发子弹完成.
我们还在补充材料中根据不同的自愿活动清单审查我们的框架。

blocks.en:
We evaluate on 32 images drawn from diverse benchmarks from robotics, relighting and image enhancement, comprising 10 from Hypersim [ 25 ] ,
4 from LuxRemix [ 16 ] , 10 from BAID [ 20 ] ,
7 from MIT-Adobe FiveK [ 1 ] , and 1 from RoboDojo [ 5 ] with complex lighting conditions, diverse geometry and materials. The whole testing set contains 17 real photographs and 15 synthetic images, covering 22 indoor and 10 outdoor scenes.
blocks.zh:
我们评价32幅来自机器人、再光和增强图像的各种基准的图像,其中10幅来自Hypersim[25],
4出自"鲁克思雷米克" [16],10出自BAID [20],
7出自麻省理工-阿多比五K [1],1出自RoboDojo [5],照明条件复杂,几何和材料多样. 整个测试集包含17个真实相片和15个合成相片,覆盖了22个室内场景和10个室外场景.

blocks.en:
We evaluate source-view consistency using PSNR [ 31 ] ,
SSIM [ 30 ] , LPIPS [ 37 ] ,
and DreamSim [ 7 ] .
Following SceneRig [ 19 ] , we assess 3D reconstruction quality from the source view and nearby views at ± 15 ∘ \pm 15^{\circ} .
By orbiting the camera around the world vertical axis through a pivot located four scene units along the original camera’s viewing direction, we use GPT-6-Astra as a judge to compute the mean-centered Bradley-Terry scores among these rendered pairs, with higher scores indicating
stronger relative preference.
blocks.zh:
我们使用 PSNR [31] 评估源视图的一致性,
SSIM [30], LPIPS [37], , , (原始内容存档于2019-09-30).
和"梦想"Sim [7].
在SceneRig [19] 之后, 我们从 + 15\\pm 15\\Circ} 的 源头视图和附近视图评估 3D 重建质量 。
通过环绕世界垂直轴线的相机绕行,通过一个位于原相机取景方向上四个场景单元的支点,我们用GPT-6-Astra作为判断器计算出这些制成对中以中心为中心布拉德利-特里的分数,更高的分数表明
相对偏好

blocks.en:
We compare with recent SoTA image-to-code reconstruction methods, including VIGA [ 35 ] , 3DCodeVerse [ 8 ] , SceneRig [ 19 ] .
All these methods use GPT-6-Astra as the backbone VLM with the same loop iterations and API. We additionally compare GPT-6-Sol with Codex [ 22 ] harness.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了最近的SoTA图像到代码重建方法,包括VIGA [35], 3DCodeVerse [8], SceneRig [19].
所有这些方法都使用GPT-6-Astra作为主干VLM,具有相同的循环迭代和API. 我们还将GPT-6-Sol与Codex [22] 牵引装置进行比较.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Qualitative comparison between other SoTA image-to-code baselines. Across diverse indoor and outdoor scenes, our LightHarness better preserves object arrangement and characteristic lighting effects, including strong back-lighting, localized illumination, and structured cast shadows, achieving more faithful reconstructions of scene structure and appearance.
blocks.zh: 图4:其他SoTA图像到代码基线的定性比较. 我们的灯光照亮在各种室内外场景中,更好地保存了物体的排列和典型的照明效果,包括强大的回光、局部照明和结构化的投影,实现更忠实地重建场景结构和外观。

blocks.en: 4.2 Image-to-Code Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4.2 图像到代码重建

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 compares reconstructions across diverse geometry and lighting conditions.
Our method better captures window–foreground contrast, localized illumination around bedside lamps, and combined window and ceiling lighting in the hall.
It also preserves furniture arrangement and foreground animal composition, while competing methods exhibit layout distortions, simplified geometry, or mismatched illumination, supporting joint reasoning about scene structure, materials, and lighting. Notably , our method infers unseen light sources and structures through their illumination effects.
In the fifth row, it reproduces striped shadows across the bedroom wall and bedding while preserving their spatial relationships, whereas competing methods miss these shadows or misinterpret the layout.
The cast shadows in the last row further illustrate lighting reasoning beyond appearance , enabling more faithful image-to-code reconstruction.
We present more visualized results under nearby views in the Supp.
blocks.zh:
图4比较了不同几何和照明条件的重建.
我们的方法更能捕捉出窗子 — — 前置对比,
它还保留了家具安排和前地动物组成,而相竞争的方法则表现出布局扭曲,简化了几何,或者不匹配的发光,支持关于场景结构,材料,和照明的联合推理. 值得注意的是,我们的方法通过光源和结构的发光效应推断出它们看不见的光源和结构.
在第五行中,它复制了横穿卧室墙和被褥的被条纹阴影,同时保留了它们的空间关系,而相竞的方法则忽略了这些阴影或误解了布局.
最后一行的投影进一步说明光线推理超越外观,使得能更忠实地进行图像到代码重建.
我们在《补编》的附近观点下提出了更多可视结果。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Hard case verification. Our method more faithfully reconstructs the diagonal shadow and surrounding building structure relative to other methods.
blocks.zh: 图5:难以核实的案件。 我们的方法比其他方法更忠实地重建了对角阴影和周围的建筑结构.

blocks.en:
Fig. 5 compares reconstructions of a scene with a prominent diagonal cast shadow.
While competing methods distort or omit this shadow, LightHarness better reproduces its spatial extent while preserving the surrounding building structure.
This result supports the value of enriched evidence and persistent lighting memory in relating shadow patterns to scene geometry and illumination, enabling more faithful image-to-code reconstruction under challenging lighting.
blocks.zh:
图5将一个场景的重建与显著的对角投影相比较.
虽然相竞争的方法扭曲或省略了这个阴影,而光Harness在保留周围建筑结构的同时,更好地复制了它的空间范围.
这一结果支持了丰富证据和持续照明记忆的价值,将阴影图案与场景几何和发光联系起来,使得在具有挑战性的照明下能够更忠实地进行图像到代码重建.

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that our method achieves the best PSNR, LPIPS, and DreamSim among the compared methods.
Relative to the recent SoTA method, VIGA, LightHarness improves PSNR by 0.75 dB and reduces DreamSim by 10.7%, indicating our superiority in both pixel-level fidelity and perceptual similarity.
The VLM-based evaluation and user preference further demonstrate our advantages at the scene level, ranking it first in all criteria covering completeness, layout, and appearance.
These consistent preferences support the effectiveness of our framework in reconstructing scene composition and visual appearance.
blocks.zh:
表1显示,我们的方法在比较方法中实现了最好的PSNR,LPIPS,和DreamSim.
相较于最近的SoTA方法,VIGA,LightHarness将PSNR改进了0.75 dB,将DreamSim减少了10.7%,表明我们在像素级忠诚度和感官相近性上的优越性.
基于VLM的评价和用户偏好进一步展示了我们在场景层面的优势,在涵盖完整性,布局,外观的所有标准中排名第一.
这些一贯的偏好支持了我们框架在重建场景组成和外观方面的效力。

blocks.en: The latency mainly includes evidence extraction, GPT API and Blender rendering in the generation-verification loop. For a 768 × \times 576 image, these three parts cost 4.5 minutes, 118.8 minutes, and 1.1 minutes respectively. The latency is comparable with other baselines (VIGA [ 35 ] for 71.2 minutes and 3DCodeVerse [ 8 ] for 126.3 minutes). The critical bottleneck is API invocation, while other parts are relatively efficient with less than 6 minutes on two 4090-48 GB GPUs.
blocks.zh: 延迟主要包括取出证据,GPT API和Blender渲染在生成-验证回路. 768x\times 576相片,这三部分分别花费4.5分,118.8分和1.1分. 耐久性与其他基线(VIGA[35]分71.2分,3DCodeVerse [8]分126.3分)相仿. 关键的瓶颈是API引用,而其他部分相对高效,在两台4090-48GB GPU上不到6分钟.

blocks.en: We invite 29 participants to rank the reconstructed scenes according to (1) scene structure fidelity and (2) lighting appearance fidelity, using the reference images as guidance. We achieve the first-place preference rate on both criteria, indicating stronger human preference for its reconstruction of scene structure and illumination.
blocks.zh: 我们邀请29名与会者根据(1) 场景结构的忠贞度和(2) 照明外观的忠贞度,利用参考图像作为指导。 我们在这两个标准上都达到第一位置的偏好率,表明人类更倾向于重建地貌结构和照明。

We report four appearance consistency metrics covering PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and DreamSim, and measure novel-view consistency by a mean-centered Bradley-Terry (BT) score which is estimated from pairwise judgments using an additional ± 15 ∘ \pm 15^{\circ} view following SceneRig [ 19 ] .
Bold and underline indicate the best and second-best.

blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Qualitative ablation of key designs. Our full framework reproduces scene layout and illumination more precisely, while removing individual components introduces errors in basic scene layout (c), light placement (c-f), and light source shape (e).
blocks.zh: 图6:关键设计的质量下降。 我们的完整框架更准确地复制了场景布局和照明,而去除单个组件则引入了基本场景布局(c),光放(c-f)和光源形状(e)的错误.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Quantitative ablation experiment. We evaluate on a 16-image subset for efficiency. Our full model achieves the best. BT scores are re-normalized here.
blocks.zh: 表2:定量衰减实验. 我们评价一个16-图像子集,以提高效率。 我们的完整模式最成功 BT的分数在这里重新正常化.

blocks.en: We conduct quantitative and qualitative ablation experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of each design in our framework in Fig. 6 and Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们在图6和表2中进行了定量和定性消减试验,以展示我们框架中的每项设计的有效性。

blocks.en: We disable the light and geometric evidence in Sec. 3.2 , observing significant reconstruction error. As shown in Fig. 6 (c), the agent misjudges the wall light’s distance from the surface and misses background illumination.
blocks.zh: 我们关闭了3.2Sec中的光和几何证据,观测到重大的重建错误。 如图6(c)所示,特工误判了墙上灯光与地表的距离并错过了背景照明。

blocks.en: Discarding explicit constraints on geometry features leads to incomplete scene light reconstruction, as shown in Fig. 6 (d).
blocks.zh: 如图6 (d)所示,放弃对几何特征的明确限制会导致场景光重建不完整.

blocks.en: Discarding lighting measurement produces wrong light source shapes and mismatched local illumination strength as shown in Fig. 6 (e).
blocks.zh: 如图6(e)所示,丢弃照明测量会产生错误的光源形状和不匹配的局部发光强度.

blocks.en:
We compare our full model with a variant that retains only current scene code and parameter values.
Without memory, background illumination is missed as shown in Fig. 6 (f), highlighting the value of explicitly organizing light source hypotheses and diagnostic history across iterations.
blocks.zh:
我们把我们的完整模型和一个只保留当前场景代码和参数值的变体进行比较.
如图6(f)所示,没有记忆,就忽略了背景照明,突出了明确组织光源假说和诊断历史在整个迭代的价值。

blocks.en: 4.4 Generalizable Applications
blocks.zh: 4.4 通用应用程序

blocks.en:
Building upon the precise executable scenes we reconstruct, our framework supports diverse downstream applications, including scene texture editing, harmonious object insertion, versatile relighting, and degraded illumination restoration.
We also demonstrate that our rendered edits can combine with the frontier generative model, GPT-Image [ 23 ] to produce more physically realistic results.
Note that simply applying generative models is hard to achieve precise physical modeling like lighting interaction with complex shadows and textures. Our integration with GPT-Image enables advanced editing ability.
blocks.zh:
我们的框架在我们重建的精确可执行场景的基础上,支持各种下游应用,包括场景纹理编辑、和谐物体插入、多功能再照和已退化的照明还原。
我们还表明,我们的编辑可以与前沿基因模型GPT-Image[23]结合,以产生更实际的结果。
请注意,仅仅应用基因模型很难实现精确的物理模型,如与复杂阴影和纹理的照明相互作用. 我们与GPT-Image的集成使高级编辑能力得以实现.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Application of texture editing. Our method supports texture replacement with multiple reference images with precise and executable code reconstruction, while directly applying even front-tier generative models leads to inaccurate structure.
blocks.zh: 图7:纹理编辑应用. 我们的方法支持用多个参考图像来替换纹理,以精确和可执行的代码重建,同时直接应用甚至前级基因模型会导致结构不准确.

blocks.en: Our method can perform exact texture editing with multiple references in Fig. 7 .
blocks.zh: 我们的方法可以进行精确的纹理编辑,在图7中多处引用.

blocks.en: Our method achieves superior light control relative to simply applying GPT-Image, as shown in Fig. 8 and Fig. 9 .
blocks.zh: 如图8和图9所示,我们的方法实现了相对于仅仅应用GPT-Image的优越光控.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Application of relighting with realistic reflection.
blocks.zh: 图8:采用有现实反思的再光.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Application of relighting with realistic shadow.
blocks.zh: 图9:以现实的阴影放出再光的应用.

blocks.en: Our framework enables physically realistic object insertion as shown in Fig. 10 .
blocks.zh: 如图10所示,我们的框架允许物理上现实的物体插入。

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Application of harmonious object insertion. Our method (b, d) enables physically realistic lighting, reflection, occlusion and geometric projection, while (c) generative model-only method struggles with these real-world principles.
blocks.zh: 图10:和谐物体插入的应用. 我们的方法(b,d)可以使物理上现实的照明、反射、闭塞和几何投影成为可能,而(c) 基因模型-唯一方法与这些现实世界的原则相冲突。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion, Limitation and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论、限制和未来的工作

blocks.en:
We propose LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that integrates explicit lighting reasoning and persistent light-source memory into image-to-code 3D reconstruction.
Complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination evidence guides reconstruction, while rubric-based assessment and VLM diagnosis support iterative refinement.
Lighting reasoning memory preserves source identities, evidence, semantic relationships, and revision history, enabling coherent reasoning across rounds.
Quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate our improved reconstruction fidelity under challenging shadows and complex illumination compared to recent SoTA methods.
Based on the accurate programmatic scene reconstruction, our framework enables rich applications, including relighting, harmonious object insertion, material and texture editing with plausible physical modeling.
blocks.zh:
我们提出"光Harness"(LightHarness),这是一个基于VLM的代理框架,将明确的照明推理和持续的光源内存整合到图像到代码3D重建中.
补充的几何、内在和发光证据指导重建,而基于分红的评估和VLM诊断则支持迭代完善。
点亮推理记忆保存了源身份,证据,语义关系,以及修正历史,使各轮推理得以一致.
与最近的SoTA方法相比,在具有挑战性的阴影和复杂的照明下,质和量的结果表明我们的重建忠心有所改进。
根据准确的方案场景重建,我们的框架使各种应用得以丰富多彩,包括重新点亮、和谐的物体插入、材料和纹理编辑以及可信的物理模型。

blocks.en:
Our framework remains limited in inferring unseen scene objects from sparse and overlapping shadow cues.
As shown in Fig. 11 , it fails to reconstruct the off-frame people and sign suggested by their shadows, leaving the corresponding shadow patterns incomplete.
blocks.zh:
我们的框架仍然有限,无法从零星和重叠的阴影提示中推断出看不见的场景物体。
如图11所示,它未能重建出框的人并用他们的影子来签名,使得相应的阴影模式不完整.

blocks.en: Future work. We will incorporate complex scene examples through in-context learning and post-train open-source VLMs on challenging datasets to strengthen reasoning about unseen objects and their interactions with light. Reducing token budget is also meaningful. We argue that projecting visual representation back to executable codes is a highly promising direction in this field.
blocks.zh: 未来工作。 我们将通过内文字学习和列车后开源的VLM,将复杂的场景实例纳入挑战数据集,以加强对看不见物体及其与光的相互作用的推理. 减少象征性预算也是有意义的。 我们认为,将视觉表现投射到可执行代码上是该领域非常有希望的方向。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Limitation on complex invisible lighting reasoning. Although effective, our framework still struggles with inferring complex invisible objects from scarce light and shadow cues.
blocks.zh: 图 11:限制复杂隐形照明推理. 我们的框架虽然有效,但仍难以从稀少的光和阴影提示中推断出复杂的无形物体。
